mentions.name: Paperwing
mentions.description: An open-source news aggregator for the open web that pulls in content from HN, Bluesky, Lemmy, Mastodon, and imported RSS feeds. It incorporates decision-model features that can identify possible spoilers in comments and gauge spiciness levels in comment sections.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I started working on a little news aggregator which has kinda spiralled into more of an open web thing. Keeping it open source, and open to feedback on how to better improve it.

I’ve tinkered with some decision model stuff too, and it can do things like identify possible spoilers in comments, or spiciness levels in comment sections. Works with HN, Bluesky, Lemmy, Mastodon, and can import RSS feeds too.

https://paperwing.io/
mentions.author: j0rdans
